I've planned round 264 as **L46-CONTRACT-CHECKS**, and `b-next.json` says **CONTINUE**. No app source was touched; the store tree is still clean at `28c4f83`.

**Round 263 result**
- C passed all 8 rows in the browser (`browserVerified` true) with 0 bugs.
- Gate 263 published rounds 262 and 263 as `28c4f83`, so that commit is the new baseline.
- SABA-B-9 is now marked done in the backlog, with C's evidence.
- Saba's open questions about the Master row and the transport layout stay `awaiting_user`.
- The next regression round is due on or after 2026-11-02, so not yet.
- The round-263 task is saved as `tasks/round-263.md`, an exact copy; nothing was deleted.

**Round 264 task**
This round covers the half of Saba's parked checks that the cloud can test honestly: the shortcut handlers themselves. The real-platform half (Windows AltGr keyboards, Mac Cmd and Ctrl+click, VoiceOver/NVDA, Safari) stays with Saba. C lists it as "not run here", neither pass nor fail.
- **A** writes two new files and edits nothing:
  - a test file, `meta-shortcuts-ui.test.tsx`. It checks that Cmd/Meta does the same as Ctrl for undo, redo (two keys), split and loop, plus one row proving Alt alone does nothing.
  - implementation doc 197. Round 261 set the precedent: a test-only round that adds a file still gets a doc.
  - A also builds two broken copies of the code outside the store and shows the new tests go red against them.
- **C** checks in the browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720:
  - Meta gives the same result as Ctrl for each shortcut.
  - The AltGr key state is ignored by Ctrl+Alt+O.
  - When the Overview is hidden, focus moves to "Expand video" (with a visible focus ring) before the status message appears.
  - What happens to focus when the grid menu is opened the macOS Ctrl+click way.
  - Anonymous visitors cannot reach purchased audio.

**Probe findings**
I ran the browser checks once myself on the baseline, so every claim in the task has a re-runnable command (K1–K12).
- **Meta keys:** Meta matches Ctrl on every shortcut tested.
- **AltGr:** the AltGr-flagged key event is correctly ignored.
- **Overview:** focus lands on "Expand video" as intended.
- **GATE244-S4 reproduces in the cloud:** if you start typing in the library search field and open the grid menu by the simulated Mac Ctrl+click path, focus ends up on the page body instead of returning to the field.
  - I ruled it stays a **Low** in the deferred polish list, with this new evidence attached. The rule that reopens parked checks only covers Mediums, and Lows wait for the polish pass.
  - It is not reopened as a task now. C's row records it rather than failing the round.
  - That Mac Chrome sends this exact click sequence is still unconfirmed; it belongs to Saba's platform check.

**Advisor:** available. I consulted it before writing and again before finishing. The second review led me to:
- tag every untagged code fact in the task;
- actually measure the focus ring instead of writing an unmeasured pass condition;
- say that the broken-copy tests run on the new file only;
- grant doc 197 instead of skipping the doc.

No project subagents were consulted.

**Architecture:** SABA-B-9 has reached its feature boundary, so I added a short, non-blocking note for root to the existing transport-positions architecture checkpoint. Nothing is scheduled from it.

**What comes next:** after round 264, SABA-B-11c (an Ableton expert check on how off-grid clips snap comes first), then SYS-6. If round 265 is planned on or after 2026-11-02, it becomes the regression round instead.
